# QCustomPlot

`qcustomplot.cpp` and `qcustomplot.h` form a separate OBJECT target. Project
integration adjusts include paths while preserving original third-party source
and embedded license notices. This directory maintenance does not upgrade the
component. Origin/license verification remains the historical U06 deferred item.

See the [Phase2 history index](../../docs/maintenance/phase-history-cleanup/HISTORY.md#phase-2)
for original scope and deferred work.
